answer: An admission auction stops fake identities. Each epoch, 50 seats open: applicants bid twice their 30-day earnings, a costly signal of commitment; top bidders win, losers are refunded. Like a cedar, a seat grows slowly: winners lock their bid for 20 epochs, and double-voting forfeits it. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 60 coins = 60,000, far above what they could share. An honest agent pays once and begins its voyage earning undiluted rewards.
